data.question: Write a program that reads an attendance value and a Y/N identification-card answer, then prints whether the exam is allowed.

brief.summary: Grants exam permission with at least 75% attendance or an identification card.

sections.heading: Question
sections.body: Write a program that reads an attendance value and a Y/N identification-card answer, then prints whether the exam is allowed.

sections.heading: What the supplied code does
sections.body: It strips the last character of the attendance with A[:len(A)-1] and converts the rest to int, so the value must end with a non-digit character.

sections.body: Output depends on the input. The test cases below show exact stdout values captured by running the supplied code.
